title: M3-3 DvP audit remediation 2: opportunity volume and scoring efficiency (A09, B07 extensions)
objective: Owner audit AUD-02. Admit nflverse player and team statistics (the exact files the FFA targets were built from) through a versioned admission with the firewall's rules and field catalog; build per team-game-position opportunity volume (QB dropbacks and carries, RB carries and targets, WR/TE targets, K FG and PAT attempts, D/ST opponent plays) with receptions and D/ST sack and turnover counts; reconcile player volumes with team totals and points with volumes; report coverage, true zeros, missing and invalid cells; measure volume and efficiency allowed reliability separately (REML k, season-cluster intervals) and their duplication; add actual-history-only forward predictors (volume channel, efficiency channel, both) through the exploratory hook, compared with B00, B03, B06 and the retained non-touchdown B07 on common rows; all EXPLORATORY, declared in config before results, never changing frozen candidates.

review.summary: AUD-02: A09 split points by scoring rule only; B07 used non-touchdown points; true volume was called unavailable. Arbit already holds it: gamebook.OPPORTUNITY_COLUMNS (attempts, carries, targets, fg_att, pat_att), team_features opps_pg, feature_specs opp_dvp_<pos>_opps_pg. nflverse stats_player and stats_team carry every needed count with no nulls in 2016-2025, and the field catalog classifies them as history (generic fantasy points excluded). The frozen provenance allowlist has no stats source and provenance.py is frozen, so a versioned admission with the same rules is needed. Each season's FFA targets manifest pins the exact stats files used.

plan.summary: 1) arbit_model.dvp.opportunity: versioned admission (admit_realized) with the firewall's rules; volume per cell (QB dropbacks + carries, RB carries + targets, WR/TE targets, K FG + PAT attempts, D/ST the offense's plays) with components; cells with missing/zero/ok status and ratio efficiency; reconciliation of player sums with team statistics; coverage; REML reliability of points, volume and efficiency allowed with season-cluster intervals and their correlation. 2) explore.make_opportunity_extra: volume channel b07v, efficiency channel b07e, both b07ve, training-only k, ratio-of-sums efficiency with a league pseudo-volume prior; explore.compose. 3) dvp_explore.py: --config version, opportunity command, composed hooks, B07 comparison and term correlations. 4) config/dvp/explore-v3.json declared before results. 5) Tests. 6) Recorded run, OPPORTUNITY_EFFICIENCY.md, records.
